rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something continues without stopping or persists.

example.english: My computer is constantly crashing, and it is really making me frustrated.
example.traditional: 我部電腦不停咁死機，真係搞到我好燥。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 bat1 ting4 gam3 sei2 gei1 zan1 hai6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 cou3

rows.note: Use this for something that keeps happening repeatedly, especially in complaints such as constantly reminding someone.

example.english: You are constantly reminding me to bring an umbrella—aren’t you annoying?
example.traditional: 你成日提住我帶遮，煩唔煩呀？
example.jyutping: nei5 seng4 jat6 tai4 zyu6 ngo5 daai3 ze1 faan4 m4 faan4 aa3

rows.note: Use this when constantly means always or invariably being the case.

example.english: They are constantly late and never on time.
example.traditional: 佢總係遲到，從來都唔會準時。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung2 hai6 ci4 dou3 cung4 loi4 dou1 m4 wui5 zeon2 si4
